```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(magick)# For image manipulation
library(hemispheR)# For binarization and estimating canopy measures
library(dplyr)
require(tictoc)
require(data.table)
library(parallel)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)  
library(tidyverse) # For data manipulation
library(imager) # For image display    
library(exifr) # For extracting metadata  
library(future.apply)
library(devtools)
require(tictoc)
```
set up directories and read the mask
```{r}
base_dir <- "./canopy_photos"

dir.create("canopy_metrics_final", showWarnings=FALSE)
# dir.create(file.path(base_dir,"binarized"), showWarnings=FALSE)
# dir.create(file.path(base_dir,"metrics"), showWarnings=FALSE)
# dir.create(file.path(base_dir,"review_panels"), showWarnings=FALSE)
## selected options from tests in prepare_canopy_metrics.rmd
options <- expand.grid(
  channel = c("2BG"),
  gamma = c(1.6),
  stretch = c(FALSE)
)

mask <- file.path(base_dir,"mask","HemiPhotoMask.svg")

image_mask <- image_read(mask) |>
  image_transparent("white") |>
  image_convert("png")
```


Calculate canopy metrics
```{r}
source("./_functions/binarize_image.R")
source("./_functions/calculate_canopy_metrics.R")
source("./_functions/make_par_image.R")
source("./_functions/calculate_yearly_PAR.R")
source("./_functions/calculate_gap_fraction.R")



selected_images <- list.files(
  file.path(base_dir,"standardized_hemi"),
  full.names=TRUE
)

#selected_images <- selected_images[1]




tic()

all_metrics <- future_lapply(
  selected_images,
  calculate_canopy_metrics,
  options = options,
  future.seed = TRUE
)

toc()

metric_table <- bind_rows(all_metrics) |> dplyr::select(plot_id, site, canopy, DIFN, PAR_Transmit, PAR_TotalUnder, Le, L, Omega,
                                                        Direct_Transmit, Diffuse_Transmit, MTA.ell, LX, LXG1, LXG2, everything())


fwrite(
  metric_table,
  file.path(
    "canopy_metrics_final",
    "hemisphere_light_metrics.csv"
  )
)
```
